title: Fluence Energy fiscal Q2 2026 results exhibit
excerpt: Fluence reported approximately USD 5.6 billion backlog and USD 412.9 million total cash at March 31, 2026, and reaffirmed fiscal-2026 revenue of USD 3.2-3.6 billion and adjusted EBITDA of USD 40-60 million.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer exhibit confirms record storage backlog and fiscal-2026 guidance while showing thin margins, negative first-half adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow, and material backlog conversion, project execution, working-capital, tariff, warranty, and liquidity risks.
